The Demon Deacons were led by fourth-year head coach [[Danny Manning]] and played their home games at the [[Lawrence Joel Veterans Memorial Coliseum]] in [[Winston-Salem, North Carolina]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 11–20, 4–14 in ACC play to finish in 14th place. They lost in the first round of the [[2018 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to [[2017–18 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]]. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|Demon Deacons]] finished [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 19–14, 9–9 in [[2016–17 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in tenth place. They defeated [[2016–17 Boston College Eagles men's basketball team|Boston College]] in the first round of the [[2017 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to advance to the second round where they lost to [[2016–17 Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball team|Virginia Tech]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 11 seed in the South region.
